The team was led by eighth-year head coach [[Jamie Dixon]], and played their home games at [[Schollmaier Arena]] in [[Fort Worth, Texas]] as a member of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|Horned Frogs]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 22–13, 9–9 in [[2022–23 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in a tie for fifth place. Due to a tiebreaker, as the No. 6 seed in the [[2023 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]], they defeated [[2022–23 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]] in the quarterfinals, before losing to [[2022–23 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]] in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 6 seed in the West Region, where they defeated [[2022–23 Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball team|Arizona State]] in the first round before losing to [[2022–23 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]] in the second round. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
